# Choosing running shoes

Foam rolling and light mobility work help, but they do not replace rest days. Increase total distance by about ten percent per week and take a lighter week every month. Shoes should fit with a thumb width of space in front of the longest toe. Most weekly mileage should be easy enough to hold a conversation.

## Open questions

Intervals such as six times eight hundred metres build speed without the strain of a full race. Most weekly mileage should be easy enough to hold a conversation. Taper for ten days before a half marathon so the legs arrive fresh.
